name: SOLVA Runtime Security Layer
purpose: Provide a deterministic enforcement boundary outside SOLVA intelligence for sandboxing, credential isolation, network/tool restrictions, runtime monitoring, and evidence capture without increasing agent authority.
architectural_position: SOLVA Intelligence -> Mission/Intent -> Policy Engine -> Authorization Gateway -> SRL -> Sandboxed Execution -> Independent Sentinel -> Verification -> Audit -> Outcome

integration_contract.policy_engine: defines permitted capability and data/network boundaries
integration_contract.authorization_gateway: binds identity, target, scope, approval, request fingerprint and idempotency
integration_contract.sentinel: independent monitor/block authority; agent cannot disable or bypass
integration_contract.audit: records security-relevant transitions and evidence references
integration_contract.outcome_assurance: consumes verified execution and outcome evidence

promotion_rule: SRL implementation may be marked TESTED only after deterministic contract tests and failure-injection tests pass. Production use requires intended-runtime evidence, applicable G08/G09/G11 controls, and explicit G12 release approval. SRL never grants new authority.
